code_dependencies.title: Generic visit binder: remove human_capital walk gate
code_dependencies.current_behaviour_VCS: Walk only starts when SettlementId=="human_capital"; avatar + entry probes + companion (Rowan) are hardcoded Human/Paragon/Knight paths.
code_dependencies.required_change_DP: Replace human_capital string checks with a data-driven FSoulSettlementVisitProfile read (walkable flag, entry probe points, avatar mesh/anims, optional companion). Keep ALL physical ground/collision/sightline validation verbatim.

code_dependencies.title: Per-settlement development-scenario selection
code_dependencies.current_behaviour_VCS: Development scenario is a compile-time literal: DA_Soul_HumanCapital_DevelopmentProof unless -SoulDwarfSettlementProof selects DA_Soul_DwarfHold_DevelopmentProof. Four-faction Heartland loads the Human proof regardless of which settlement the player owns.
code_dependencies.required_change_DP: Resolve the development scenario from the player's current settlement via a data-driven map {settlementId -> FSoftObjectPath}. Seed with the two existing literals; add dwarf_hold and viking_harbour rows.
code_dependencies.note: This is the single biggest code blocker to visiting a non-Human settlement in the real four-faction playtest.

code_dependencies.required_change_DP: Add immutable struct, optional per-entry parse, and a getter the GameMode can read. No new subsystem. Validate /Game/ prefixes + existence as the registry already does for maps.
